_readme: Card shops around Rochester NY, and where you can actually sit down and
play. Drives /shops.html.
WHY BUYING AND PLAYING ARE ON ONE PAGE. Round here they are the same three
buildings. A shops page with two entries and a league page with two entries
is two thin pages; one page that answers both is worth reading.
Add a shop with a name and a url. Everything else is optional and simply
does not render when missing: area, address, phone, hours, blurb, goodFor,
and the whole play block.
URLS ARE CLEANED ON PURPOSE. A link copied out of a shop's own site often
carries tracking or session parameters (_su_rec, utm_, fbclid and friends).
Those point at one browsing session, they rot, and they hand a third party a
record of where the visitor came from. Link the plain page instead.
`visited` marks a shop that has appeared in a video. Set it when a rip is
filmed there so the page can say so.
PLAY TIMES ARE NOT PUBLISHED UNLESS THEY ARE CONFIRMED. League nights move,
get canceled, and go quiet over the summer. Where a store's official Play!
Pokemon league page and a secondhand listing disagree, the page says they
disagree and sends you to the shop, because the cost of being wrong here is
somebody driving across town to a dark room.
ROCHESTER NY ONLY, and its ring. A national search for 'Rochester Pokemon
league' returns Rochester MINNESOTA and Rochester MICHIGAN above ours, and
both of those were nearly listed here. Check the zip: ours are 146xx.
That trap is live, not historical. On 15 August 2026 a search for Rochester
Pokemon leagues returned a 'Rochester Sports Cards And Memorabilia League'
(407 S Main St, Rochester MICHIGAN) and a 'Rochester Pokemon League' at
NerdinOut (1802 2nd St SW, Rochester MINNESOTA). Both look local until you
read the zip.
WHERE EACH ENTRY CAME FROM, and when it was read. Every fact below was taken
from the business stating it about itself, not from a directory. Read
15 August 2026 unless noted:
Just Games        justgamesrochester.com/category/pokemon/ states the
address, phone and the Mon-Sat noon-9, Sun noon-6 hours.
Millennium Games  shop.millenniumgames.com footer states the address,
phone and the hours added on this pass.
LingSter Games    lingstergames.com/shop states the address, phone and
hours. See the move note below.
Legacy Games      legacygamestore.com states address, phone and hours;
singles.legacygamestore.com lists priced Pokemon singles
under the same name and address.
Great Lakes       glgaminglounges.com/pokemon prices packs, ETBs and
booster boxes; /tcg states Wooper Wednesday at 6.30pm.
WeTheHobby        wethehobby.com/pages/contact states address, phone and
hours; /pages/events lists a Pokemon Weekly League on
every Thursday of the current month.
TWO SHOPS PUBLISH HOURS WE DELIBERATELY DO NOT CARRY. Great Lakes Gaming's
only self-stated hours sit inside an Instagram caption reproduced on their
home page, and that same caption still advertises events 'Coming January
2026', so it is stale and the hours in it cannot be trusted. WeTheHobby's
own contact page reads 'SAT 11pm to 8pm', which is impossible; 11am is what
is recorded here. Prefer omitting an hour to inventing one.
LINGSTER MOVED, and the old address is still all over the internet. Their
own blog has a September 2025 post opening a brick and mortar at 4675 West
Ridge Road, Spencerport 14559, then a June 2026 post opening the current
shop at 1586 West Ridge Road, Rochester 14615. Aggregators mix the two, and
the Spencerport hours (Mon/Wed/Fri 2-7pm) still surface first. The address
and hours in this file are the ones on lingstergames.com/shop today.
SHOPS CHECKED AND LEFT OUT, so nobody re-researches them: Yankee Clipper
House of Cards, Comics Etc, Boldo's Armory, Endzone Collectibles / In The
Zone, Game On, Hammergirl Anime, All Heroes Comics, Rochester CCG, Flower
City Cards, PokeSalesByRoc, Hobby House Toys. Each failed on one of: its own
site never says it sells Pokemon, it has no storefront, or its address is
reported two different ways with nothing from the business to settle it.
Directory sites are not evidence: tcglist.org tags all 23 of its Rochester
listings with the identical 'Magic, Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh' trio, including a
playing card manufacturer and a craft store.
playNote: Play! Pokemon league schedules change constantly and go quiet between seasons. Call the shop before you drive.

shops.name: Just Games
shops.hours: Mon to Sat noon to 9pm, Sun noon to 6pm
shops.blurb: Rochester's flagship game store and the one with the busiest Pokemon calendar. Prereleases every set, a learn to play session for anyone starting out, and League Challenges and Cups through the year.
plays: Prerelease weekends for every new set
League Challenge and League Cup events
Gym Leader Challenge, a casual format away from standard
Learn to Play sessions with loaner decks
shops.playNote: They run a regular league but do not publish a fixed weekly time, so check the events calendar or call the counter.

shops.name: Millennium Games
shops.address: 1225 Jefferson Road, Suite A17, Rochester, NY 14623
shops.hours: Mon to Sat 10am to 10pm, Sun 10am to 6pm
shops.blurb: One of the biggest game stores in the area, with a Pokemon section to match and a sanctioned league of its own.
shops.playWarn: Their official Play! Pokemon league page currently reads Inactive with no sessions scheduled, while other listings still describe a Monday league night. Call them before you go.

shops.name: LingSter Games
shops.hours: Wed to Sat 11am to 9.30pm, Sun 11am to 6pm, closed Mon and Tue
shops.blurb: Deep Pokemon singles and sealed, and the first stop when a set drops.

shops.name: Legacy Games
shops.hours: Mon to Sat 11am to 9.30pm, Sun noon to 7pm
shops.blurb: The Webster one, and the furthest east of these. They run a separate singles storefront alongside the main site, so you can see which Pokemon singles are actually in the case before you make the drive. They buy cards too.

shops.name: Great Lakes Gaming
shops.address: 100 S Clinton Ave, Suite 22, Rochester, NY 14604
shops.blurb: Not a shop front. It is a gaming lounge on the 22nd floor of an office tower downtown that sells Pokemon packs, Elite Trainer Boxes and booster boxes at the counter and gives Wednesday night over to Pokemon.
plays: Trading card game and video game, plus Pokemon Go and Unite
shops.playNote: The Wednesday time is off their own trading card games page. Being on the 22nd floor, it is a lift and a parking garage rather than a door off the street, so leave a few extra minutes.

shops.name: WeTheHobby
shops.area: Arlington Street, Neighborhood of the Arts
shops.hours: Mon to Wed noon to 6pm, Thu and Fri noon to 8pm, Sat 11am to 8pm, Sun 11am to 6pm
shops.blurb: Mostly sports cards, and better known for breaking live online than for a Pokemon singles case. The Arlington Street building is a real shop and lounge you can walk into though, and there is a Pokemon league in it every week.
shops.playNote: Their own events calendar carries the league on every Thursday of the current month, but does not publish a start time. Check the calendar or ask when you walk in.
